video_title: How Tyrese Haliburton got 50 Cent to PERFORM at his wedding

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the pressures of being an NBA player
quotes.excerpt: It's interesting when you get married and you're an NBA player, it can feel a little big time.
quotes.quote: It's interesting when you get married and you're an NBA player, it can feel a little big time. But because of where my girl is from and where I'm from, smaller towns made it feel very Midwest, very at home, which was fun.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: How Tyrese Haliburton accidentally leaked his 50 Cent wedding surprise
quotes.excerpt: I sent it to him, I went to sleep, and when I woke up, my phone was blowing up.

text_blocks.speaker: Unidentified Host
text_blocks.text: I remember seeing a video of you congratulating 50 Cent on a residency.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: 50's team called me because 50's my man. They asked if I could make this video for his residency to congratulate him. We got home late night and I was a little drunk. I thought this is probably funny, so I sent it to him. I went to sleep, and when I woke up, my phone was blowing up. I'm thinking I posted it. Nah, I texted it to him. He thought it was funny, so he posted it and it was everywhere. By the time I could even tell him to take it down, it was too late.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: Tyrese Haliburton on the high cost of booking performers
quotes.excerpt: 30 minutes? 750 bands. I was shocked. I was like, that's not happening.

text_blocks.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
text_blocks.text: Who could we get to perform? We went to a bunch of different people. He was helping me look for a bunch of different people. Prices are kind of crazy. I was not prepared for that. What are people talking these days for a performance? 30 minutes? 750 bands. I was shocked. I was like, that's not happening.

quotes.speaker: Tyrese Haliburton
quotes.summary_phrase: 50 Cent's surprise appearance at Tyrese Haliburton's wedding
quotes.excerpt: He was like, I'm not going to come to the wedding because I want it to be a surprise.
quotes.quote: He was like, I'm not going to come to the wedding because I want it to be a surprise. Don't tell anybody. I literally didn't tell anybody. You have some people getting ready to peel out, and I'm like, hey man, you might want to wait just a little bit. And then he came in with Yayo and Murda and everybody. It was dope. Forever I got his back, forever for that.
